meta.name: x-article-publisher
meta.description: Publish Markdown articles to X (Twitter) Articles editor with proper formatting. Use when user wants to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or mentions "publish to X", "post article to Twitter", "X article", or wants help with X Premium article publishing. Handles cover image upload and converts Markdown to rich text automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 Markdown 文章发布到 X 并自动排版
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常写 Markdown 并想一键发布到 X 文章。
copy.tagline_en: Publish Markdown articles to X with auto formatting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write in Markdown and want to publish to X Articles in one click.

howto.what: Claude 会读取 Markdown 文章，解析出标题、封面图和正文，然后自动打开 X Articles 编辑器，填好标题、粘贴转成富文本的内容，最后保存为草稿（不会自动发布）。文章缺标题或封面图时，Claude 会生成标题或调用生图工具生成封面图。
howto.when: 当你说“publish to X”“post article to Twitter”等关键词，或要求把 Markdown 文章发布到 X Articles，或求助 X Premium 文章发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我把 article.md 发布到 X Articles
say.note: Claude 会解析文件并打开浏览器，保存为草稿

say.text: 这篇博客链接能发成 X 文章吗？顺便起个标题
say.note: 缺标题时 Claude 会按内容生成

say.text: 为 /tmp/文章.md 生成一张封面图再发布
say.note: 缺封面时 Claude 会调用生图工具生成

howto.what_en: Claude reads the Markdown article, extracts title, cover, and body, then opens the X Articles editor, fills in the title, pastes rich-text content, and saves as a draft (never auto-publishes). If title or cover is missing, Claude generates a title or calls an image generator.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention “publish to X”, “post article to Twitter”, or “X article”, want to publish a Markdown file/URL to X Articles, or ask for help with X Premium article publishing.

say_en.note: It parses the file and saves a draft in the browser

say_en.text: Can this blog link become an X article? Suggest a title too
say_en.note: It generates a title if missing

say_en.text: Generate a cover for /tmp/文章.md and publish it
say_en.note: It calls the image tool when no cover exists
